items.title: File Widerspruch against hedge-trimming order
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter is dated Mon 29.06.2026 and no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so 29.06.2026 is the posting day. The Landratsamt is a general (Kreisverwaltungs-)authority, not a tax office, so the 4-day delivery fiction (posted 1 Jan 2025 or later) applies without weekend/holiday shift: delivery day = 29.06.2026 + 4 calendar days = Fri 03.07.2026 (this day is not itself moved even though it is not a weekend here anyway). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO analogue for BY administrative acts) starts the day after delivery (delivery day itself not counted, §§ 187, 188 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 03.07.2026 -> 03.08.2026 (Monday). This is a working day in Bavaria, so no further shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG is needed.

items.title: Cut back hedge to property line
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: This obligation runs from 'Bestandskraft' (the point when the order can no longer be challenged), not from delivery. Assuming no Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft occurs the day after the one-month Widerspruch period expires, i.e. on 04.08.2026 (the day after 03.08.2026). Counting the three-week period from the day after that triggering day (§§ 187, 188 BGB): start 05.08.2026 (Wed), three weeks later on the same weekday = 26.08.2026 (Wed), which is a normal working day so no further shift applies. This date is only an estimate: it depends on the recipient not lodging a Widerspruch, and the letter does not itself define when 'Bestandskraft' is deemed to occur.

warnings: The hedge-trimming task deadline ('innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft') is contingent on the order becoming final, i.e. on no Widerspruch being filed within the one-month period ending 2026-08-03; the computed date 2026-08-26 is therefore only an estimate and will be pushed back further if a Widerspruch is lodged or if the authority issues a separate ruling on it.

The account/IBAN shown in the footer is the authority's own general banking information printed on all its letters, not a payment demand tied to this specific order — no payment is requested in this letter.
